description_en: Queries the real-time status report of one or more specified agents in a specified instance
description_zh: 调用ListRealtimeAgentStates获取指定实例下一个或多个指定坐席的实时状态数据报表
name: ListRealtimeAgentStates

parameters.help_en: Filters the results by skill group ID. This parameter is optional. Default value: empty, which indicates that no filtering is applied
parameters.help_zh: 按技能组ID过滤，非必填，默认为空，表示不过滤
parameters.name: skill_group_id

parameters.help_en: The page number. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The list of agent IDs. The format is a JSON array character string that contains up to 20 array elements. This parameter is optional. Default value: empty, which indicates that all agents in the current instance are matched
parameters.help_zh: 坐席ID列表，格式为JSON数组的字符串，数组元素最多20个，非必填，默认为空，表示匹配当前实例下的所有坐席
parameters.name: agent_id_list

parameters.help_en: Filters the results by status list. This parameter is optional. Default value: empty, which indicates that all statuses are matched
parameters.help_zh: 按状态列表过滤，非必填，默认为空，表示匹配所有状态
parameters.name: state_list

parameters.help_en: Performs a fuzzy match based on the agent name
parameters.help_zh: 按坐席名称进行模糊匹配
parameters.name: agent_name

parameters.help_en: Filters the results by work mode list. This parameter is optional. Default value: empty, which indicates that all work modes are matched
parameters.help_zh: 按工作模式列表过滤，非必填，默认为空，表示匹配所有工作模式
parameters.name: work_mode_list

parameters.help_en: Filters agents in outbound-only mode. This parameter is optional. Default value: empty, which indicates that agents are not filtered by outbound-only mode
parameters.help_zh: 过滤仅外呼模式下的坐席，非必填，默认为空，表示不按仅外呼模式过滤
parameters.name: outbound_scenario

parameters.help_en: Performs a fuzzy filter. The value can be all or part of the agent display name, agent ID, or agent extension number. This parameter is optional. Default value: empty, which indicates that no filtering is applied
parameters.help_zh: 模糊过滤，可以是坐席展示名、坐席工号或坐席分机号的全部或者一部分，非必填，默认为空，表示不过滤
parameters.name: query

parameters.help_en: Filters the results by call type list. The format is a JSON array character string whose array elements are call types. This parameter is optional. Default value: empty, which indicates that all call types are matched
parameters.help_zh: 按通话类型列表过滤，格式为JSON数组的字符串，数组元素为通话类型，非必填，默认为空，表示匹配所有的通话类型
parameters.name: call_type_list

parameters.help_en: The media type. Default value: Audio. Other valid values: Chat, Video, and ALL
parameters.help_zh: 媒体类型，默认是语音（Audio）, 其他可选参数包括Chat（文本）、Video（视频）、ALL（全选）
parameters.name: media_type

List.description_en: The list of real-time agent status data
List.description_zh: 实时坐席状态数据列表

BreakCode.description_en:
The break code.

Valid values:

RingingTimeout: The break caused by an agent ring timeout.

RejectCall: The break caused by an agent rejecting a call.

Warm-up: The temporary break state before an agent goes idle after coming online
BreakCode.description_zh:
小休码。

枚举值：

RingingTimeout：坐席振铃超时导致的小休。

RejectCall：坐席拒接导致的小休。

Warm-up：坐席上线后置闲前的临时小休状态

CounterParty.description_en: The counterparty used in specific three-party scenarios, mainly monitoring, coaching, and consulting. In a three-party scenario, it represents the third party. For example, in a monitoring or coaching scenario, it represents the monitored or coached agent. In a consulting scenario, it represents the transferred agent or the outbound number
CounterParty.description_zh: 用于一些特定的三方场景，主要是监听，辅导，咨询，在三方场景时表示第三方，比如在监听或辅导场景，用于表示被监听或被辅导的坐席，在咨询场景下，表示被转接的坐席或外呼号码

Duration.description_en: The duration of the current state, in seconds
Duration.description_zh: 当前状态的持续时长，单位秒

Extension.description_en: The extension number of the agent

Mobile.description_en: The personal phone number of the agent

OutboundScenario.description_en: Indicates whether the agent is in outbound-only mode
OutboundScenario.description_zh: 坐席是否处于仅外呼模式

SkillGroupIdList.description_en: The list of skill group IDs that the agent is signed in to
SkillGroupIdList.description_zh: 坐席签入的技能组ID列表

SkillGroupNameList.description_en: The list of skill group names that the agent is signed in to
SkillGroupNameList.description_zh: 坐席签入的技能组名称列表

StateCode.description_en: The sub-status. In some scenarios, the State field alone cannot fully represent the agent status, so a sub-status is required. For example, in the monitoring state, State is Talking and StateCode is Monitoring
StateCode.description_zh: 子状态，部分场景下，仅用State字段无法完整表示坐席状态，因此需要子状态辅助，比如监听状态下，State=Talking，StateCode=Monitoring

StateTime.description_en: The time when the state started. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
StateTime.description_zh: 状态开始的时间。格式为 Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒

PageNumber.description_en: The page number. Valid values: 1 to 100

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100
